## About
Brass Tap & Billiards is a pool hall and bar in the Starmount Shopping Center on Capital Blvd in Raleigh. Pool. Beer. Friends. That's pretty much the whole idea.
There's always something on the calendar. APA and Carolina TAP leagues, the Raleigh Dart League, and our own pool tournaments on Thursday and Friday. Saturday's just as good for a game. Come by for a drink and something from the food and drink menu.
We're rated 4.4 on Google from 361 reviews. One reviewer stopped in to shoot pool with her son and friends and called the bartenders warm and courteous.

## Services
- Brass Tap 8 Ball Tournament: Our Thursday night tournament. ($20)
- Brass Tap 9 Ball Tournament: Our Friday night tournament. ($20)
- APA 8 ball / 9 ball League: APA league play on Tuesday and Thursday.
- Carolina TAP League: League night on Monday.
- APA Masters League: Also on Monday.
- Raleigh Dart League: Darts on Wednesday.
- Domestic Bottle Special: Sunday and Wednesday. ($2.25)
- 16 oz PBR can: Sunday and Wednesday. ($2.00)

## FAQ
Q: Are you open every day?
A: Yes, we're open every day of the week.

Q: Where are you?
A: We're in the Starmount Shopping Center on Capital Blvd in Raleigh.

Q: Do you serve food?
A: Yes. We've got a food and drink menu to go with your game.

Q: How do I keep up with tournaments and events?
A: Follow us on Facebook. That's where we post updates, and we go live during tournaments and other events. We're on Instagram too.
